options.content:
Individual Flow Information

This dashboard shows additional flow information for the selected flow.
The first table shows information common to both endpoints, while the other tables show information unique to each endpoint.
Please note that retransmit and RTT information are only available for archive flow data;
and rate and duration will be zero for flows where only one sample was detected.
All times are displayed in browser local time.
